cycle_complete.scope: After engine setup through all resets/warmups/measurements/IO/flushes/finalize/observer export/shutdown; excludes initial setup and writing this final marker. Parent process wall includes those too.

protocol.question: On the real-over-HBM Qwen BF16 model, does reducing fixed prefill32 to16 change the tradeoff among existing generation gaps, arriving-request delay and full-cost transfer amortization?
protocol.prerequisite: Successful full-loading/request/KV accounting already observed; original numerical diagnostic difference retained. Performance requires the new frozen layer47 same-partition partial/final bitwise attribution gate and all48 finite references in this same startup.

workload.scope: Four existing public sources outside Qwen qualification0..3, retokenized using same frozen Qwen tokenizer; not a globally untouched dataset or quality holdout. Prefixes, output limits and absolute arrivals frozen before Qwen performance outcomes; no clock selected from reference-run timing.

protocol.ordering: Single engine32/16/16/32 ABBA; two observations per arm with run-order dependence. Descriptive exploratory comparisons, not independently randomized repetitions.

warmup.scope: Both static shapes warm every cell; same prompts reused for warmup and measurement. Pager slots/maps/LRU reset and engine/KV drained after warmup; KV free-block queue not rewritten, allocations remain common.

protocol.accounting: TTFT equals declared-arrival-to-submission lag plus native queue until first schedule plus first-schedule-to-first-token. Entire cohort wall includes queueing and synchronous-submit lag; do not add them again. Independent policy state/routes/free outputs; payload measured from actual copy requests, not wire bytes. Group count alone is not total cost. Host/GPU spans may overlap.
metrics: whole finite-cohort wall and output throughput
engine calls, scheduled positions, expert groups, actual tensor-copy payload
whole lifecycle and memory; separate setup/warmup/capture/flush/shutdown
required_checks: 16 measured requests/416 outputs and4x388 positions; warmup32 requests/64 outputs separately
all ready decode scheduled once, no preemption
each16/32 threshold applied before native.schedule and actual prefill sizes recorded
pure decode unique<=32 and1expert group perlayer; this does not imply0misses
each policy own future KV/routes/output and all attempts retained
same-arm repeats and adverse metrics retained, no empirical maximum declared noise bound
protocol.strongest_baseline: The stronger measured ordinary static among16 and32 for each metric within this same resource configuration. Two points are not a globally optimized static or exact Oracle.
protocol.claim_ceiling: Measured full-request tradeoffs on one finite clock episode, one true-over-HBM model and this backend. No new scheduler, production p99, statistical significance/noninferiority, sustained capacity, task quality/equivalence or expert-history decision-value claim.
protocol.stop: GPU query/foreign process, source/input/resource mismatch, missing request/position, ready-decode omission, preemption, nonfinite or failed integrity stops with evidence retained. Do not tune seed, arrival times or thresholds on this episode.
protocol.closure: Positive, negative or tradeoff result closes this bounded true-over-HBM comparison and supports a measurement synthesis with the prior OLMoE/artificial-budget results. Retain unproven online selector/history increment and quality/capacity limits; do not automatically launch another mechanism.
protocol.loading: Single official BaseModelLoader lifecycle. Sixteen ordered frozen hash-checked shards streamed one at a time; clone each CPU tensor to break mmap ownership, native Qwen load_weights copies into target. Remove only owned successful consumed shard copies; preserve failed partial file and receipt. Strict source coverage and target return-name coverage; native postprocessing and eval retained.

memory_budget.boundary: Actual whole lifecycle sampled. memory.stat file includes shmem and is not wholly reclaimable. Anonymous threshold is not a proof of physical RAM headroom; total current/limit/OOM events retained.

startup_localization.reason: The completed Qwen run has complete requests/loading/KV and finite48-layer references, but the original .01/.01 allclose diagnostic fails at layer47. One same-precall partition replay is required before performance; combining both scopes avoids another full5498.824sload.

startup.same_pre_call: Within each new replay, identical cloned hidden/topk/weights. Old hidden tensors were not retained; original pattern matching is reported separately and never called old-hidden bitidentity.

execution_guard.scope: Nonblocking whole-session flock before GPU preflight, through loading, numerical qualification, all four static cells, worker termination and terminal write; held FD inherited by own worker, never explicit LOCK_UN.
execution_guard.failure: Busy/query/foreign/source/resource error aborts; only this Popen(start_new_session=True) child PGID may receive TERM/KILL. No automatic retry. SIGTERM/SIGHUP/SIGINT reach parent cleanup; SIGKILL/host loss cannot promise a final receipt.
execution_guard.signal_handlers: Parent only; 17 runtime files and original detached launcher unchanged.
execution_guard.preflight: Three empty samples five seconds apart; any busy/query failure immediately aborts, no queue polling.
execution_guard.terminal: launch.json atomic updates; child reaped before close; detached receipt retains CHILD_EXITED. Parent missing terminal remains UNKNOWN until independent reconciliation.
execution_guard.source_input_scope: Scientific fields and original package_files30/source_sha25617 unchanged from Q3. Only new_host/current identity evidence and administrative path/storage/identity recording updated.
execution_guard.identity_recording: launch.host_identity_before/after captures boot_id, raw PID1 stat, start ticks, SC_CLK_TCK, kernel btime and derived PID1 start unix; launch.gpu_identity captures actual UUID/total before model initialization. Missing final identity is recorded without replacing earlier failure.

current_gpu_identity_evidence.scope: Parent read-only current-instance observation, not fresh launch idleness. Startup checks actual UUID/size, host identity and per-filesystem capacity again; full208CPU list not copied. No inherited prior-host timing evidence.

scope: Four frozen requests per cell, one engine ABBA, both ordinary static thresholds at identical budgets. Common warmups use the same four prompts with two outputs, followed by drain/reset; this is not a quality holdout. Every repeat and policy-specific route/output difference is retained. No noise bound, significance, quality, SLO, Oracle or method GO.
timing_scope: Full capture wall equals exclusive engine-call phase wall plus outside gap, including clock idle and synchronous submission delay. TTFT equals submission lag plus native queue to first schedule plus first-schedule-to-first-token. CPU time, host apply, CUDA spans and GC overlap are not added together or subtracted. Shared engine/process costs are reported separately, not allocated to arms.
boundary_scope: Matching empty pager/allocation metadata is not KV tensor bitwise equivalence. Weight-copy bytes are actual tensor payload, not measured PCIe wire traffic. Reference qualification is disabled in these captures. GPU checks and finite hardware samples only cover recorded boundaries. Static thresholds take effect before each native schedule; drained resets reestablish shared-engine state between cells.
